confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge; no live listings or booking pages were inspected. Restaurant and coffee anchors are firmer; accommodation ranges are wider, and July is rainy season, so no deep off-season discount was applied. Cocktail and wine are set at about 3.2-3.3x the beer anchor because direct price knowledge for them is weaker. Accommodation assumes VAT and typical service charges are included. The FX figure (0.6955, 15 Oct 2026) comes from a search-result summary attributed to the RBA exchange-rates page; a second search could not reconfirm it, so verify against the RBA daily table before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. Regional basis: Southeast Asian large-city price levels (e.g., Bangkok, Kuala Lumpur, Ho Chi Minh City), with local food priced low and imported alcohol priced high due to import duties; accommodation reflects visitor districts such as Malate/Ermita, Makati and Pasay.
